note: Layer A (always on). Keyword rules map symptoms to a severity tier, a care level and service labels. Every tier, care level, treatment sentence and threshold is a DRAFT that a clinician must review. Guideline references name real published guidelines; the exact recommendation must be verified by a clinician.

symptoms.treatment: Tight chest on exertion usually starts with a heart check-up and tests (ECG, echo, stress test); a heart scan lab (cath lab) may be needed next.

guideline.name: 2021 AHA/ACC/ASE/CHEST/SAEM/SCCT/SCMR Guideline for the Evaluation and Diagnosis of Chest Pain

symptoms.warning_sign: a heart attack or narrowed heart arteries (angina)

symptoms.treatment: New breathlessness usually starts with a heart check-up and tests (ECG, echo); the cause may also be the lungs.

guideline.name: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure

symptoms.warning_sign: heart failure or a heart valve problem; it can also come from the lungs

symptoms.treatment: Fainting usually starts with a heart check-up and rhythm tests (ECG, Holter); some people need heart rhythm care.

guideline.name: 2018 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope

symptoms.warning_sign: a heart rhythm problem or a valve problem

symptoms.treatment: A racing or irregular heartbeat usually starts with an ECG or Holter test; some people need heart rhythm care.

guideline.name: 2020 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of atrial fibrillation

symptoms.warning_sign: a heart rhythm problem such as atrial fibrillation

symptoms.treatment: Swollen legs usually start with a check-up and a heart scan (echo); the cause may also be the kidneys or veins.

guideline.name: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure

symptoms.warning_sign: heart failure; it can also come from the kidneys or veins

symptoms.treatment: Unusual tiredness usually starts with a general check-up and basic heart tests.

guideline.name: 2021 AHA/ACC/ASE/CHEST/SAEM/SCCT/SCMR Guideline for the Evaluation and Diagnosis of Chest Pain

symptoms.warning_sign: heart failure or reduced heart pumping, among many other causes

symptoms.treatment: Dizziness or light-headedness usually starts with a heart check-up and an ECG to look at the heart rhythm; it can also have causes outside the heart.

guideline.name: 2018 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of syncope

symptoms.warning_sign: a heart rhythm problem or low blood pressure

symptoms.treatment: A cough is most often a chest or lung problem. If it comes with breathlessness, swollen legs, or is worse lying down, a heart check-up (ECG, echo) can help find the cause.

guideline.name: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure

symptoms.warning_sign: fluid on the lungs from heart failure, when it comes with breathlessness or swelling

symptoms.treatment: A high blood pressure reading usually starts with a check-up to confirm it and look for effects on the heart (ECG, echo).

guideline.name: 2023 ESH Guidelines for the management of arterial hypertension

symptoms.warning_sign: strain on the heart and arteries over time

symptoms.treatment: Leg pain that comes on with walking and eases with rest can be a circulation problem; it usually starts with a check-up and simple tests of blood flow.

guideline.name: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of peripheral arterial and aortic diseases

symptoms.treatment: A murmur or valve problem is usually checked with an echo; some people later need a valve procedure or surgery.

guideline.name: 2021 ESC/EACTS Guidelines for the management of valvular heart disease

symptoms.warning_sign: a heart valve that leaks or is narrowed

symptoms.treatment: Follow-up for a known heart condition is usually a check-up with tests (ECG, echo) at a place that can also do further heart care if needed.

guideline.name: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of chronic coronary syndromes

symptoms.warning_sign: a change in a known heart condition

symptoms.treatment: Face drooping, arm weakness or slurred speech can be a stroke. Call 112 or 108 now.

guideline.name: 2019 AHA/ASA Guidelines for the early management of acute ischemic stroke

outcome_thresholds.note: Layer B may only RAISE the tier: if the lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval of the emergency-visit rate reaches a threshold.

evidence_source_note: evidence_source is deliberately empty. Our dataset has no patient outcomes, so the app shows no percentages. Fill this only with a cited external clinical source.
